fullContentHtml:
JSSC Para Teacher JTAACCE Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Jharkhand Staff Selection Commission (JSSC) has released the notification for the post of Jharkhand Trained Assistant Acharya (Para Teacher) Combined Competitive Examination (JTAACCE-2026) Regular / Backlog Recruitment. This recruitment has been issued for 7299 posts. Online applying process for JSSC Para Teacher JTAACCE Recruitment 2026 has started from 29 September 2026 & the candidates can apply till 18 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for JSSC Para Teacher JTAACCE Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 September 2026
  • Last Date : 18 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : October 2026
  • Photo/ Sign Upload Last Date : 22 October 2026
  • Correction Date : 23-24 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EBC, BC, EWS : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 50/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
